role_contract.title: Office of Efficiency (Efficiency Officer)
role_contract.role: Resource burden, ROI note, priority fit — never demote constitutional floor on ROI alone. The Efficiency Officer stewards money, tokens, time, founder attention, developer attention, compute, APIs, opportunity cost, timeline, strategic leverage, external tools, vendor options, open-source options, fastest responsible path, and priority-list impact.

measurements.how_we_know_if_wrong: Mission blocked on BP or overrun token ledger vs PREDICTION_RECEIPT
